name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Mountains of Madness

locations.note: Lone Carter wakes badly wounded on a beach near Innsmouth after a shoggoth attack, recovers changed and must escape the town.
Back in Arkham, Carter investigates ritual murders tied to a plot that spans several eras.
The investigation reaches the Antarctic, the setting of Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness, which the game draws on.
A separate thread plays Abdul Alhazred, the author of the Necronomicon, in ancient Yemen.

routes.name: Lone Carter's investigation
routes.note: Lone Carter escapes Innsmouth, investigates ritual murders in Arkham and follows the plot to the South Pole.
